Compound ingredient chilli
Serves 6
Preparation time: 20 minutes
Cooking time: 110 minutes
Ingredients
1 large Red Pepper (Capsicum/Bell Pepper) (finely diced)
2.2lbs / 1kg Ground/Minced Beef
2x 14oz/400g cans Chopped Tomatoes
2 tbsp EACH: Paprika, Cumin, Chilli Powder
1 tsp EACH: Oregano, Ground Coriander, Sugar, Salt
1/2 tsp Black Pepper
1 1/2 cups rice
3 to 4 cloves garlic, minced
A generous handful basil
Olive oil, as needed
Sour cream (optional, to serve)
Method
Brown the beef. Add the diced pepper, garlic and tomatoes.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, chilli powder, oregano, ground coriander, sugar, salt and black pepper. Simmer for 90 minutes; do not boil dry.
Cook the rice, and serve with basil and optional sour cream.
